headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update | Sector: Cement SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of 2QFY27 result Muted 2QFY27 performance impacted by monsoon disruptions and weak realizations: Star Cement (SCL) reported muted revenue growth of 2.5% YoY during the quarter due to soft pricing environment and a mere 2.0% volume growth (cement+clinker), although cement sales volume grew 4.8% YoY to 1.1 mn tonnes.
Northeast (NE) cement volumes grew 4.2% YoY to 0.8 mn tonnes while sales outside NE grew better by 5.8% YoY to 0.3 mn tonnes.
On the profitability front, EBITDA dropped 19.3% YoY due to lower government subsidy accruals following the GST rate cut, softer monsoon realizations and elevated fuel costs.
PAT decline was steeper at 44.3% YoY, dragged by higher interest cost (up 37.5% YoY).
valuation: Groundwork will start in Dec’26 and commissioning are targeted by 2QFY29.
Near-term Outlook: Management expects a strong pent-up demand in 2HFY27, targeting 12%-13% YoY volume growth across 3Q and 4Q.

Maintain Buy – Reduce Target Price to Rs 210: Star Cement delivered decent volume growth in 2QFY27 despite a seasonally soft monsoon quarter, though profitability was weighed down by normalized subsidy accruals, muted pricing and temporary coal logistics disruptions.
